name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.314.0 — Add /spec:fanout — one session runs the lanes: a driver-stepped fan-out over worktree-isolated sub-agents with batched question relay, serial merge with a gate after each, and one rendered report. 7.313.0 — /spec:plan's collision check now also fires when a Decision extends a pinned list (a spec-paths key or section list, a policy seat, a closed enum, a frozen table), with the list's name among the literals — a section-list extension in 20261102/02 broke an existing pin the plan never saw. 7.312.0 — delegated driver stops on disk: core § Delegated Stops, run.md already-in-worktree skip, fix.md delegated question kinds.
